clue.text: Backing track's infused with energy as well

indicators.note: something infused with a substance has it steeped inside it, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: the B-side is the track on the back of a single
E is the physics symbol for energy
the possessive ending supplies its letter

explanation.surface: A musician's backing track is full of energy as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'infused with' puts E inside B-SIDE'S. 'Backing track' looks like a session-music term, but it is the flip side of a vinyl single.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides, used as an adverb, is a synonym for also or in addition.

clue.text: Act to make Belgium and Spain secure

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)
to secure something is to obtain or have it

explanation.surface: A political act intended to make two European countries safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Act' looks like a noun, a law; it is the verb, to conduct oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: To behave is to act or conduct oneself in a particular way.

clue.text: Reason to head north, because it's in New York

indicators.note: in a down answer heading north means reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: as can mean because

indicators.note: this piece sits inside the next one

explanation.surface: A reason to head north from New York, because that's where it is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to head north' signals a reversal because this is a down answer, read upwards; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Reason in the sense of sound mind or good sense is a synonym of sanity.

clue.text: Facial feature that could give good health?

definitions.text: Facial feature that could give good health?

parts.words: Facial feature that could give good health?
parts.note: a chin repeated gives the toast chin-chin, which wishes good health

explanation.walkthrough: 'Chin-chin' is an old toast meaning good health, so a chin doubled gives it.
explanation.definitionFit: A double chin is a fold of fat beneath the jaw, a feature of the face.

clue.text: Traitor's written up something heard in India

indicators.note: in a down answer, written up means the letters run from bottom to top

parts.note: a rat is a traitor or informer
here the apostrophe s stands for is

explanation.surface: A traitor's deeds are reported in a newspaper and the news is heard in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written up' reverses RAT IS.
explanation.definitionFit: The sitar is a long-necked plucked instrument of Indian classical music.

clue.text: One stocking rolls round on roller

indicators.note: the first piece goes round the second, enclosing it

parts.note: a baker is someone who stocks bread rolls
RE means on or about, as in a letter's subject line

explanation.surface: Someone with a stocking has it roll down round their leg, on a roller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rolls' suggests movement or hosiery, but it is bread; 'round' is the container signal, and 'on' means concerning.
explanation.definitionFit: A breaker is a large wave that curls over and crashes, and a roller is another name for such a long wave.

clue.text: Officer could get broken rib, I raged

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces that can be put together differently

explanation.surface: An army officer complains: I broke a rib and flew into a rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges RIB I RAGED.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigadier is a senior army rank, commanding a brigade.

clue.text: Some beasts wetly kiss, missing occasionally

indicators.note: every other letter is missed out, leaving alternate letters

explanation.surface: Some animals give wet kisses, though now and then they miss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing occasionally' keeps the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of WETLY KISS.
explanation.definitionFit: Elks are large deer, so they are some of the animals of the forest.

clue.text: Jersey's assembly in progress?

parts.note: the jersey is a woollen sweater, still being made with needles

explanation.walkthrough: Jersey looks like the Channel Island with its parliament, the States Assembly, sitting; it is a pullover being made.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitting is the craft of looping yarn into fabric, how a woollen jersey is made.

clue.text: 'Get Out of Denver', e.g., is terrific record

indicators.note: the answer is got out of the words that follow, lying hidden among them

explanation.surface: A music review: the song Get Out of Denver is a terrific record.
explanation.walkthrough: The song title is the hidden-word signal, getting the letters out of denveR EG IS TERrific.
explanation.definitionFit: A register is an official written record or list, such as a register of births.

clue.text: Back uniform required for worshipper

parts.note: hind means at the back, as in hind legs
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A worshipper must wear a uniform at the back of the congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu is a follower of Hinduism, so one who worships within that religion.

clue.text: Second Starfleet win — Klingon's captured

indicators.note: the answer is held captive within the run of clue words that follows

explanation.surface: A Star Trek battle report: the Federation's Starfleet wins and a Klingon is taken prisoner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'captured' signals the letters inside starfleeT WIN KLINGon's.
explanation.definitionFit: In a twinkling means in an instant, so the word stands for a very short moment, like a second.

clue.text: Very good being in possession of unusually rational brain?

indicators.note: the shuffled letters hold the next piece, so it sits inside them
unusually signals that the letters of rational are arranged in a new way

explanation.surface: Someone very good is blessed with an unusually rational brain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' reworks RATIONAL into ITALORAN, and 'being in possession of' puts G inside it, after V. The question mark flags brain as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The brain is one example of an organ the body cannot survive without, hence the question mark.

clue.text: 'Duck' backed what he did on 'Dock of the Bay'

definitions.text: 'Duck' backed what he did on 'Dock of the Bay'

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, so it gives O

indicators.note: the letters of this piece are written backwards

parts.words: what he did on 'Dock of the Bay'
parts.note: the song is (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay, so he would sit

explanation.surface: A trivia question about the singer of the soul hit, with a pun on duck and dock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' is the reversal signal. The whole clue also defines: he is the singer of (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay.
explanation.definitionFit: Otis Redding recorded (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay in 1967, so he is the man who sat there.

clue.text: Escorts in nurse, supported by soldiers

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits beneath, so it comes after

parts.note: to nurse a patient is to attend to them
soldiers are a caste of ant, so ants stands for them

explanation.surface: Escorts are found in a nurse's company, backed up by soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Attendants accompany and wait on someone, as escorts do.

clue.text: Dancing a cancan, quite intimate? Not quite!

indicators.note: dancing letters move about, so the fodder is rearranged

explanation.surface: Performing a cancan feels rather intimate, the dancer admits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dancing' rearranges A CANCAN QUITE. The definition plays on how far short of intimacy the relationship falls.
explanation.definitionFit: An acquaintance is someone known only slightly, a person short of being a close friend.

clue.text: Exposed rash

definitions.meaning: ... also means careless or incautious, as in an ... remark

explanation.definitionFit: Unguarded covers both senses: left without defence, and speaking without due caution.

clue.text: Blue-chip maker put in liquidation?

indicators.note: liquidated things are broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A prestigious manufacturer has been put into liquidation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in liquidation' rearranges MAKER PUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Both expressions describe high quality and prestige, as blue-chip shares are the most reliable on the market.

clue.text: Resign, not working after favourite's taken over

indicators.note: the not-working piece comes after the other one
taken over means turned over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, with the apostrophe s added
a computer system that is down is not working

explanation.surface: A manager quits, idle, after the favourite has taken over the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken over' reverses PETS into STEP.
explanation.definitionFit: To step down is the idiom for leaving an official position voluntarily.

clue.text: Imposing ecofriendly sports venue

parts.note: imposing a rule is putting it on someone
green means environmentally friendly

explanation.surface: An impressive, environmentally sound new stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Imposing' reads as grand, but it is the verb: putting something on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A putting green is a smooth grassed area for golf putting, so a small place where a sport is played.

clue.text: Something waiter's given to European creep

parts.note: a tip is a gratuity handed to a waiter

explanation.surface: A waiter hands something to a sneering European creep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'creep' looks like a noun for an unpleasant person; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To tiptoe is to walk quietly on the balls of the feet, which is to creep.

clue.text: Core unit of dozens, a large number being radical

indicators.note: the core is the central part, so the middle two letters are taken

parts.note: a lot is a large number

explanation.surface: A tale of dozens of units in which a large number turn extreme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Core unit of' takes ZE from the middle of DOZENS.
explanation.definitionFit: A zealot is a fanatic, someone with radical views pursued with extreme zeal.

clue.text: Record's entered when they go almost three miles high

definitions.text: they go almost three miles high

indicators.note: the record goes into the other piece, entering it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A record is set when climbers reach nearly three miles up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record' tempts as a feat, but it is the vinyl album; 'entered' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Mont Blanc, the highest of these European mountains, is about 4,800 metres, close to three miles.

clue.text: Pub garden rage, gulping whiskey — it's spiked

indicators.note: the anger piece swallows the next one, taking it inside

parts.note: a bar is a pub, or the room in one
a bed is a plot in a garden
ire means anger or rage
W is whiskey in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A furious pub garden scene with someone downing whiskey, and a drink that has been spiked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gulping' is the container signal, taking the whiskey letter into the run of three pieces. 'spiked' suggests a doctored drink, but the definition means having spikes.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbed wire is fencing wire twisted with sharp points along its length.

clue.text: Capital Radio's cultivated

indicators.note: words on the radio are only heard, so the next word is judged by how it is pronounced

parts.note: bred means raised or cultivated, as of plants or animals

explanation.surface: A boast that the London station Capital Radio has a refined audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital Radio' reads as the name of a London station; split it, and 'Radio's' signals the sound of BRED.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread is slang for money, and capital is money used to fund a business.

clue.text: Parasite's request not soft-headed but the opposite

indicators.note: the head letter for soft, as in musical notation, is swapped for its opposite, loud

parts.note: a plea is an earnest request

explanation.surface: A parasite asks to be considered not foolish but quite the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: In music P (piano) is soft and F (forte) is loud: the clue swaps the initial P of PLEA for F.
explanation.definitionFit: A flea is a small biting insect that lives as a parasite on animals' blood.

clue.text: We learn that king today left to go to border

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
now means at the present time, today
an edge is a border or rim

explanation.surface: A history lesson: we learn that the king left today for the border.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge is what is acquired through learning, so it is that which we learn.

clue.text: Both sides missed blatant spinning of one's delivery

indicators.note: spinning turns the letters round so they read the other way
both outer letters of the word are left out, keeping its middle

explanation.surface: A cricket umpire missed a blatant spinning delivery, the ball the bowler turns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both sides missed' strips BLATANT to LATAN, and 'spinning' reverses it. 'delivery' sounds like cricket but means childbirth.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal means relating to birth, and a delivery is the birth of a baby.

clue.text: Pot found in army vehicle parked by a road

parts.note: a tank is an armoured military vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone finds a pot inside a tank parked beside a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pot' suggests cannabis or a cooking vessel; here it is a drinking mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A tankard is a large drinking mug, and pot is an old word for such a beer vessel.

clue.text: Defect son's spotted in course

indicators.note: the son is seen inside the other piece, placed within it

parts.note: to defect is to desert one's side
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A defector's son has been seen on a training course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spotted in' puts S inside DESERT. 'course' suggests a programme of study; it is a part of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Dessert is the sweet stage of a meal, one of its courses.
